title: Advanced Future Forms
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Manejar el Future Perfect y el Future Continuous te permite describir cronogramas de proyectos (roadmaps) con precisión milimétrica, una habilidad vital para gerentes y directivos.

parts.visual:
Future Continuous (Will be + ING): 
Se usa para proyectarse a un momento específico en el futuro donde una acción estará en progreso. 
Ej: At 10 AM tomorrow, I WILL BE PRESENTING to the board. (Estaré presentando). 
Ej: Don't call them next week; they WILL BE TRAVELING. (Estarán viajando).
parts.audio: Future Continuous. Use 'will be' plus an i n g verb to project yourself into a specific moment in the future when an action will be in progress. For example: At 10 AM tomorrow, I will be presenting to the board. This means you will be in the middle of the presentation. Another example: Don't call them next week; they will be traveling.

parts.visual:
Future Perfect (Will have + Participio Pasado): 
Se usa para afirmar que una acción ya estará TERMINADA antes de un momento específico en el futuro (muy usado con 'By' - Para cuando / Antes de). 
Ej: BY Friday, we WILL HAVE FINISHED the report. (Para el viernes, habremos terminado). 
Ej: By the time you arrive, I WILL HAVE LEFT. (Para cuando llegues, me habré ido).
parts.audio: Future Perfect. Use 'will have' plus a past participle to state that an action will already be finished before a specific point in the future. It is very often used with the word 'By', which means 'before' or 'no later than'. For example: By Friday, we will have finished the report. Or: By the time you arrive, I will have left.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma futura correcta (Perfect o Continuous) según el contexto.

questions.question: Please don't call me at 3 PM. I ____ an interview with a candidate. (Estaré teniendo).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso en un momento específico: Future Continuous (will be having).

questions.question: By the end of this year, we ____ three new branches in Europe. (Habremos abierto - acción terminada).
questions.explanation: Con 'By...' indicamos que la acción estará completada: Future Perfect (will have opened).

questions.question: They ____ the new software for six months by the time it is released. (Habrán estado probando - Future Perfect Continuous).
questions.explanation: Con 'for six months' y 'by the time', se usa Future Perfect Continuous para enfatizar duración completada.

questions.question: This time next week, I ____ on a beach in Hawaii! (Estaré relajándome).
questions.explanation: This time next week = en este mismo momento pero la próxima semana. Acción en progreso: will be relaxing.

questions.question: I'm sure they ____ the problem by tomorrow morning. (Habrán resuelto).
questions.explanation: By tomorrow morning (antes de mañana) = acción terminada: will have solved.

questions.question: By 2030, many experts believe that AI ____ millions of jobs. (Habrá reemplazado).
We ____ our strategy all day tomorrow, so I won't be able to check emails. (Estaríamos discutiendo/Estarán discutiendo).
questions.explanation: All day tomorrow = acción prolongada en progreso: will be discussing.

questions.question: Let's meet at 5 PM. The CEO ____ the office by then. (Ya habrá dejado).
questions.explanation: By then = para entonces. Acción ya terminada: will have left.

questions.question: At 8 AM tomorrow, the workers ____ the new machinery. (Estarán instalando).
questions.explanation: At 8 AM = en ese momento exacto estarán en medio de la acción: will be installing.

questions.question: If we don't hurry, the meeting ____ by the time we get there! (Habrá terminado).
questions.explanation: By the time we get there = Para cuando lleguemos (ya habrá terminado): will have finished.

questions.question: Do you think you ____ reading that report by Friday? (Habrás terminado).
Tomorrow afternoon we ____ to London for the conference. (Estaríamos volando).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso en la tarde de mañana: will be flying.

questions.question: By next month, I ____ at this company for exactly 10 years! (Habré trabajado / Habré estado trabajando).
questions.explanation: Future Perfect Continuous para enfatizar la duración ('for exactly 10 years') al llegar a una fecha futura ('by next month').

questions.question: They ____ the building renovations by December. (Habrán completado).
I can't meet you for lunch. I ____ a client at that time. (Estaré entreteniendo/viendo).
questions.explanation: At that time = acción en progreso (will be seeing).

questions.question: Before the deadline arrives, we ____ all the necessary tests. (Habremos realizado).
questions.explanation: Before = antes de = acción completada: will have conducted.

questions.question: Don't ring the doorbell at 10 PM. The baby ____. (Estará durmiendo).
questions.explanation: Acción en curso: will be sleeping.

questions.question: By the time the boss returns, we ____ the presentation. (Habremos preparado).
questions.explanation: By the time... = Future Perfect (will have prepared).

questions.question: Next Tuesday at noon, the CEO ____ his speech. (Estará dando).
questions.explanation: At noon = momento específico para acción en progreso (will be giving).

questions.question: They hope that they ____ enough money to expand by 2025. (Habrán ahorrado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en Future Perfect (will have + participio) o Future Continuous (will be + -ing).

questions.question: By Friday, I ____ (finish) the report. (Habré terminado)
At 10 AM, I ____ (present) to the board. (Estaré presentando)
By 2025, we ____ (open) five stores. (Habremos abierto)
Don't call later. I ____ (sleep). (Estaré durmiendo)
By next week, she ____ (leave). (Habrá salido/ido)
Tomorrow afternoon we ____ (fly) to Paris. (Estaríamos/Estarán volando)
By the time you arrive, it ____ (stop) raining. (Habrá parado)
This time tomorrow, we ____ (relax) on the beach. (Estaremos relajándonos)
By 5 PM, they ____ (sign) the contract. (Habrán firmado)
Next month, I ____ (work) here for 5 years. (Habré estado trabajando - Future Perfect Continuous)
questions.explanation: will have been working (o will have worked).
